title: Ranorama's Radical Crosshair
description: This resource pack adds a Portal 2 crosshair!
body:
The crosshair is now Portal themed!

- This pack ONLY retextures the crosshair

- The crosshair was created in GIMP (GNU Image Manipulation Program)
